card.title: Certified Correct
card.instruction: Treat forms, standards, and exact wording as a technical craft. Correct shortcuts before discussing whether the result actually works.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Before we sign off your evacuation plan, these arrows need the approved red.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Everyone found the exit during the drill.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Good. We'll discuss that after the arrows match the sample.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The sample faded in the window.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then we need a replacement sample before we can establish what everyone successfully followed.

mechanism: A treats matching an approved color sample as prerequisite technical work even after the evacuation succeeds, then suspends evaluation when the sample is unreliable.
confusable: Unlike merely controlling an approval for personal power, A sincerely prioritizes exact standards as a craft before functional results.
comparison: The evacuation alternative protects a reference color; the cake alternative preserves correct wording and candle count despite physical interference.
provenance: Direct local assistant candidate preparation; not fresh review or acceptance.
